healthcare_pharma.published: No public pharma/healthcare creator rate premium found. Elev8or modeled: Cairo health nano 3,218 EGP vs lifestyle 2,475 (+30%) vs ecommerce 4,455 (-28%); UAE wellness nano 239 AED vs lifestyle 184 (+30%) vs fashion 220 (+9%). YouGov (via S17): 77% of UAE consumers notice influencer endorsements for healthcare/supplements, the highest of 17 markets.

beauty_skincare.published: Elev8or KSA skincare/makeup = travel baseline (nano 225-1,125 SAR); typical ER 1-4%. Luxury UAE ~+58% vs fashion at micro. YouGov (via S17): 72% of UAE consumers notice beauty endorsements.

fmcg.published: No FMCG-specific figure. Elev8or entertainment is ~17% below skincare baseline in KSA; finance +83%, SaaS +108% (illustrates niche multipliers are vendor-set).

usage_rights_whitelisting.published: Whitelisting/boosting adds 20-50% (Catchers, KSA). Usage rights up to +39% (Collabstr 2025, global, via summary).

arabic_first_uplift.published: Arabic-first content: 35-50% higher engagement than translated English content, GCC-wide (Boomerang.ae via Kolsquare and IMH). Primary study not located.

ramadan_seasonality.published: Starngage: rate spike ~40% (another Starngage guide: 20-40%) during Ramadan and National Day; bundle discount ~30%. Collabstr global seasonal +20-30%. No Ramadan CPM series found anywhere. Purchases +40.6% across 14 Muslim-majority countries in Ramadan 2024 (CampaignMe via Kolsquare).

ksa_licence.published: Mawthooq in force since 1 Oct 2022; SAR 15,000 for 3 years. Kolsquare active KOL base (5K+ IG followers) fell 35%: 60,824 to 39,377 since 2022. Saudi = ~40% of GCC influencer spend.

uae_licence.published: Advertiser Permit mandatory from 1 Feb 2026; fines up to AED 1M (2M repeat). 59% of UAE brands spend up to AED 250K/yr on influencers.

egypt_currency.published: EGP ~16/USD (2022) to >47 after March 2024 devaluation (blog, low), ~49.9 in Aug 2026 (S23). No source ties devaluation to creator fee changes. Licence EGP 50,000 for accounts >5,000 followers (Kolsquare). Active KOL base +7.5% to 64,248.

tier_effect.published: Micro-influencers show 3.5x the engagement of mega in MENA (Hovi via S17, no data shown); Starngage says 3-5x. Micro = 45% of GCC market share (MMA); 60% of MENA spend goes to macro/mega (IMH).

ksa_vs_uae_engagement.published: Older (2021) Vamp/Campaign ME: KSA influencer engagement slightly below average but impression/reach rates above UAE; KSA influencers' audiences 50-60% local vs 20-30% UAE.

fair_value_cpm_ceiling_per_1000_views.note: No published KSA/UAE/Egypt influencer CPM exists. Ceilings below are my extrapolation anchored on Modash global anecdotal ranges (S9). Same ceiling proposed for all three markets because no evidence supports a per-market split; the exception is Egypt where local purchasing power argues lower but is unevidenced.
fair_value_cpm_ceiling_per_1000_views.ksa_blended_cpm: no public data. Global anecdotal blend $7-45 (SAR 26-169); my extrapolated central planning value $15-25 (SAR 56-94) per 1,000 views.

reference.title: International benchmarks: view rate, engagement rate, CPM / CPE / CPC
reference.note: Behavioural figures are global proxies. No market-specific published data exists for KSA, UAE or Egypt by platform and tier.
how_to_read: Kind: published (PUB, a vendor or agency figure), proxy (PROXY, published but global or not market-specific, used as a stand-in), extrapolation (XTR, reasoning shown in the basis), none (no public data).
View rate = views / followers. Engagement rate is on followers for Instagram and on views for TikTok and YouTube, so the two are not comparable across platforms.
CPM = cost per 1,000 views, CPE = cost per engagement, CPC = cost per click, all in USD.
Every row shows its sources (S1 to S31). Open the Sources tab to see the publisher, year and link.
caveats: Behavioural benchmarks with a stated method exist only at global level (Socialinsider: 35M Instagram posts, about 2M TikTok videos), and they come from brand pages, not creators.
No published view rate, engagement rate, CPM, CPE or CPC exists for KSA, UAE or Egypt by platform and tier. The MMA MENA guide is said to contain one but is not public.
No Snapchat view rate, price or CPM exists anywhere. No YouTube Shorts market data. No pharma or healthcare premium. No Ramadan CPM series.
Published KSA sticker prices and CPM benchmarks do not reconcile: the overlap of vendor bands for a KSA micro creator implies SAR 375 to 844 per 1,000 views against a global anecdotal 56 to 169.
Engagement benchmarks differ by about 10x between vendors because of different populations and denominators. Never compare across sources.
Regulatory points (Mawthooq, UAE advertiser permit, Egypt licence) come from Kolsquare and need checking against the original text.
